title: [BUG] API Error: Rate limit reached on Cowork only - account-specific, persists across machines
body: ## Summary Cowork displays "API Error: Rate limit reached" immediately on every action, while Claude Chat and Claude Code work fine on the same account. Switching to a different account resolves the issue, confirming this is an account-level server-side problem. **Account usage:** Less than 30% of quota used. ## How this started I was trying to find archived Cowork sessions that were not visible in the UI. My sessions were stored in `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/local-agent-mode-sessions/` but were not appearing in Claude Desktop, despite `isArchived: false` in the session JSON files. While troubleshooting this (clearing caches, migrating session files to `claude-code-sessions/`, etc.), Cowork began returning rate limit errors and has not recovered since. ## What works - Claude Chat (same account, same machine) — works fine - Claude Code CLI (same account, same machine) — works fine - Cowork on a different account (same machine) — works fine ## What fails - Cowork on my main account — immediate "API Error: Rate limit reached" - Cowork on my main account on a second machine — same error - Cowork on my main account -- it shows the 'Failed to start Claude's workspace. Can't reach the Claude API from Claude's workspace. Restarting Claude or reconnecting to your network sometimes resolves this.' error on the GUI. ## Troubleshooting attempted (none resolved) - Cleared all Claude Desktop caches (Session Storage, IndexedDB, Cookies, Local Storage, Network Persistent State, WebStorage) - Removed OAuth token cache from config.json - Complete removal of `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/` - Cleared system-level caches (Preferences, Saved Application State, Logs, Crash Reports, Daemon Containers) - Uninstalled and reinstalled Claude Desktop - Reinstalled Claude CLI via npm - Tested on a completely separate machine — same error - `claude logout` / `claude login` — did not help ## Environment - macOS Darwin 24.6.0 - Claude Desktop (latest version, freshly installed) - Plan: Max (usage under 30%) ## Conclusion The issue is account-specific and server-side. Cowork rate limiting appears to be incorrectly applied to my account. Switching accounts on the same machine immediately resolves the problem. Requesting a server-side reset of the Cowork rate limit state for my account. # Customer Support Reference Conversation ID for your records: 215473434166037
